title: Freechapel
summary: FREECHAP'EL, noun In England, a chapel founded by the king and not subject to the jurisdiction of the ordinary. The kind may also grant license to a subject to found such a chapel. Free city, in Germa

inlines.v: FREECHAP'EL, noun In England, a chapel founded by the king and not subject to the jurisdiction of the ordinary. The kind may also grant license to a subject to found such a chapel. Free city, in Germany, an imperial city, not subject to a prince, but governed by its own magistrates.
